quest.title: The Cantankerous Fish Have Their Circumstances?
quest.description: Sigewinne seems to have something to tell us...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: #Thank you for all your hard work, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: I have a pretty good understanding of our patients' condition now, so I've mixed them up some special Melusine medicine...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Adding these herbs to the water tank should help calm them down.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you're basically turning the whole tank into a giant health spa?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That really is a plan that only you could pull off, Sigewinne!

choices.text: But won't this only temporarily relieve their symptoms?

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: You're spot on. I'll need to invite a whole variety of different fish here for physical examinations before I can determine exactly what's wrong.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: I'll put together a list of patients to check based on the characteristics I need.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: I'd appreciate it if you could keep a close eye out for any fish that meet the criteria.

choices.text: To completely cure them, we still need to find the root cause...
